name: Sphinx of Valor
summary: A celestial sphinx that claws foes, roars with escalating effects, casts spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with {ref:glossary/disadvantage}.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

actions.name: Roar
actions.text:
The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a {ref:glossary/long-rest}):

**First Roar.** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* {dc:wis}, each enemy in a 500-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from the sphinx. *Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition for 1 minute.

**Second Roar.** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* {dc:wis}, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. *Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/paralyzed} condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

**Third Roar.** *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:wis}, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. *Failure:* {dmg:8d10:thunder}, and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the sphinx can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The sphinx regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Arcane Prowl
items.text: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

items.name: Weight of Years

save.targets: one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet

items.onFailure: The target gains 1 {ref:condition/exhaustion} level. While the target has any {ref:condition/exhaustion} levels, it appears 3d10 years older.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
